elements.description: An A/B test that unfolds into the full comparison; pick a winner and run an action on it.

properties.name: variants
properties.description: The variants under test, the control first (or marked `control`) – one row and one chart column each

properties.name: metrics
properties.description: The metrics to compare on; with more than one, a switch picks which one the card shows

properties.name: metric
properties.description: The metric id shown; unset shows the first metric

properties.name: winner
properties.description: The id of the variant picked as the winner, or null

properties.name: status
properties.description: The tag under the title, e.g. { label: "Running", tone: "green" }

properties.name: note
properties.description: Short text next to the status, e.g. "Day 9 of 14"

properties.name: action
properties.description: The button that appears on the tray once a winner is picked

properties.name: hint
properties.description: Replaces the line on the tray while nothing is hovered or picked: text, or an element (cloned)

properties.name: trigger
properties.description: "hover" opens under the pointer (taps and the keyboard still toggle), "click" only on click

properties.name: open
properties.description: Whether the card is unfolded, showing the metric switch, the variants and the tray

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-open-change
events.description: The card opens or closes; detail `{ open: boolean }`. Cancelable.

events.name: tc-metric-change
events.description: Another metric was picked; detail `{ metric: string }`. Cancelable.

events.name: tc-winner-change
events.description: A variant was picked as the winner, or the pick cleared; detail `{ winner: string | null }`. Cancelable.

props.name: variants
props.description: The variants under test, the control first (or marked `control`) – one row and one chart column each

props.name: metrics
props.description: The metrics to compare on; with more than one, a switch picks which one the card shows

props.name: defaultMetric
props.description: Starting metric id when `metric` isn't controlled – defaults to the first metric

props.name: onMetricChange
props.description: Called with the id of the metric picked

props.name: winner
props.description: Controlled id of the variant picked as the winner

props.name: defaultWinner
props.description: Starting winner when `winner` isn't controlled – defaults to none

props.name: onWinnerChange
props.description: Called with the id of the variant picked as the winner, or null when the pick is cleared

props.name: status
props.description: The tag under the title, e.g. { label: "Running", tone: "green" }

props.name: note
props.description: Short text next to the status, e.g. "Day 9 of 14"

props.name: action
props.type: { label: string | ((variant: ExperimentVariant) => string); onClick: (variant: ExperimentVariant) => void | Promise<unknown> }
props.description:
The button that appears on the tray (Clean: in the last row) once a winner is picked. `label` gets the picked
variant. `onClick` may return a promise: the button waits while it runs, and a rejection says so on the tray and
lets you try again

props.name: hint
props.description: Replaces the line on the tray (Clean: in the last row) while nothing is hovered or picked

props.name: trigger
props.description: "hover" opens under the pointer (taps and the keyboard still toggle), "click" only on click

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the card starts unfolded when `open` isn't controlled

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the card opens or closes
